title: Philly Cheesesteak Bake
ingredients: 2 green peppers, deseeded and finely chopped
method: Preheat oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6.
Spray a small flameproof casserole dish or ovenproof frying pan (about 20cm/8 inches in diameter) with oil and fry the onions for 10 minutes over a gentle heat until soft and golden brown.
Meanwhile, beat the eggs in a medium-sized bowl with the milk, Worcestershire sauce and some salt and pepper.

Increase the heat, add the beef, peppers and mushrooms and stir-fry, breaking up the clumps in the meat, for about 5 minutes. Add the onion granules, garlic granules and mustard powder and crumble over the stock cube. Stir well and remove the pan from the heat.
Pour the egg mixture over, making sure you cover all the exposed beef mix, then lay the slices of cheese on top.
Bake on the middle shelf of the oven for around 35 minutes, until the cheese on top is bubbling and golden brown. Serve piping hot.
notes: Mix 1 tablespoon of chilli sauce with the egg mixture in step 3 for a bit of spice. Leftovers taste great cold or served in a bread roll for another take on the Philly cheesesteak.
